kingfix.title: KingFix
kingfix.description: More than a system: a sales engine. Intelligent scheduling with automatic distance calculation (Google Maps API) and location-based pricing. The customer chooses, the system handles logistics. Integrated checkout (Stripe), complete financial and administrative management. The definitive Mobile-First solution to scale mobile mechanic services.

devrex.title: DevRex
devrex.description: The definitive bridge for your international career. Micro-SaaS platform that uses AI to analyze profiles and automate LinkedIn applications. Find the best global remote jobs with surgical precision and increase your hiring chances.

codesampa.title: codesampa.io
codesampa.description: Engineering at the bleeding edge. Built on the Next.js 16 and React 19 (RC) ecosystem. Features native internationalization, file-based CMS (Velite), and an atomic Design System. Flawless performance (100/100) and fluid 60fps animations.

psialexia.title: Psi Aléxia Marques
psialexia.description: Pure performance focused on results. Built with Vanilla HTML, CSS, JS + Tailwind to achieve maximum Lighthouse scores and flawless SEO. The impact? Just 2 weeks after launch, patient demand was so high that the professional quit her full-time job to focus entirely on her private practice.

codelab.title: CodeLab
